lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the dark torso. Spacing is wider in the anterior-midsection and becomes progressively more compressed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most posterior line terminates approximately 50% down the lateral torso mass. Multiple lines exhibit thinning or loss of contrast as they approach the long ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 3 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the lower haunch align on a horizontal plane relative to the ventral line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate-spiral trajectory. Horns emerge from the skull at an upward and lateral angle, curve inward and backward, with the terminal tips oriented medially.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump; orange-tan lower limbs with white socks and black markings at the fetlock; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek and a white chevron between the eyes.
